data.title:
How we solved
the task
data.text:
The selection of Infosystems Jet as a partner was driven by several factors. The engineers of Infosystems Jet possess the required competencies to support a broad stack of solutions, which represents a significant contribution to ensuring stable, high performance, and uninterrupted operation of the banking infrastructure.

The first year proved to be the most dynamic and intensive. In addition to studying and gaining in depth understanding of the infrastructure, the joint team of the two companies established effective communication, developed operational regulations, and formed integration solutions for handling requests and incidents.

At the second stage, having positively assessed the results of cooperation with the service partner, the bank allowed the possibility of involving the Infosystems Jet team in the administration of certain complex application software.

Subheading

At subsequent stages, the partnership was further scaled by expanding the scope of application software administration and participation in technical support for servers and parts of the infrastructure. At the final stage of cooperation, the Infosystems Jet team took part in supporting the bank IT applications and also proposed new domestic products, which were seamlessly integrated into the IT systems. As part of the import substitution program, Infosystems Jet helps the bank consistently and confidently integrate an increasing number of Russian solutions into its operations, participating in the preparation of the infrastructure for migration processes.

In the near
future
data.text:
Many years of cooperation have helped Russian Standard Bank become an even more high-tech player in the market, meeting high industry standards.

Today, the partnership with Infosystems Jet helps implement the import substitution strategy, taking into account the requirements of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation.
